anchor: v1::Grace Odhiambo, ORD-20768. The leather hiking boots are half a size too small. Can I exchange them?

result.text: Yes, you can exchange them. I've started the return for your leather hiking boots (ORD-20768, return RMA-20768) with the reason "wrong size," and there's no fee. To get the right size, place a new order for the half-size-up pair. The replacement ships once the return is scanned at the warehouse. If you'd rather not reorder, the $159 refund comes back 5–7 business days after the warehouse receives the boots.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.

results.title: Final sale
results.body: Items marked final sale (clearance) cannot be returned or exchanged. They are still covered by the warranty against manufacturing defects.
